negatives.failure: A Windows literal wildcard passed to rg returned invalid-filename error 123.
negatives.recovery: Use rg globs or exact paths and rerun the read-only search.

negatives.failure: A generic manifest verifier treated repository-relative lifecycle paths as owner-relative.
negatives.recovery: Classify lifecycle paths as repository-relative and final-owner paths as owner-relative, then replay.

negatives.failure: A combined status and definition wrapper exceeded twenty seconds after returning branch status.
negatives.recovery: Split status, exact selection, and inventory into no-profile bounded probes.

negatives.failure: An additive transform assumed a blank-line separator that one list boundary did not use.
negatives.recovery: Initialize with apply_patch and materialize explicit structured definitions without separator inference.

negatives.failure: The first explicit-definition generator used a strict-mode reserved word as a JavaScript parameter and failed before applying a patch.
negatives.recovery: Rename the parameter to a nonreserved short identifier and rerun the same owner-scoped apply_patch materialization.

negatives.failure: The first preregistration build updated the diagnostic text to 530 prior indexed proposals but left the executable comparison at 520 and stopped after Method Flow initialization.
negatives.recovery: Retain the contradictory failure, change only the comparison to 530, let Method Flow ingest the new witness pair, and rerun the unchanged x1 build.

negatives.failure: A sequential text transformation incremented already-correct numeric replacements in the first generated x1 reviewer and test.
negatives.recovery: Retain the false replacement assumption, patch only the three exact assertions, and inspect their rendered lines before running validation.

negatives.failure: Three staged-review stabilization reads remained invalid because two generated Python files contained an extra blank line at end of file; the first read also preceded staging the two self-exclusions.
negatives.recovery: Retain every invalid receipt, remove only the two extra EOF blank lines, restage the exact files, and repeat until the two self-exclusions and diff hygiene are stable and valid.
